name: Data grid
description: An editable spreadsheet with typed columns, range selection, in-place editing, column menus, resizing, and tab-separated copy and paste.

props.name: columns
props.type: { id: string; name: string; type?: "text" | "number" | "select" | "status"; width?: number; options?: (string | { value: string; label?: string; tone?: "neutral" | "brand" | "success" | "warning" | "destructive" })[]; format?: (value: number) => string }[]
props.description: The columns. Numbers are right-aligned and summed in the footer; select and status cells pick from options, and a status shows its option as a tinted badge. Widths default by type and can be dragged at the header edge; double-click the edge to reset.

props.name: rows
props.description: The rows, keyed by column id. Passing a different array resets the grid's copy, its undo history and its sorted order.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with a new array after every edit, paste, cut, clear, undo or redo. The grid keeps working without it.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the grid for assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the frame. Give it a height; rows scroll inside and only the visible ones are rendered.
